title: An adherence lottery budget
hook: Two stated cases: explore the expected payment under an explicit lottery rule.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the expected payment under an explicit lottery rule affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Net, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the expected payment under an explicit lottery rule in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
